messages.text: Vertex checkout has been throwing 500s since 09:14 and volume is still climbing.
Calling this a P1 because the SLA clock is running and revenue is impacted.
I opened INC-4412 and attached the dashboard snapshot.
Tom is the incident owner; target is mitigation inside four hours.
I reproduced it on the staging replica using the Vertex merchant config.
Root cause is a null merchant id in the 3DS callback.
Security checklist passed, signed off in the checklist doc.
The fix is deployed to prod now.
Vertex error rate is back to baseline for the last ten minutes.
I emailed Vertex with the timeline and mitigation notes.
Who is taking the postmortem writeup before we close this?
